tools.name: lookup_order
tools.description: Look up one order by order number and customer email. Use when the user gives an order number. Returns status, items and ETA. Read-only.

order_number.description: Order number from the confirmation email, e.g. ORD-123456

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel an order that has not shipped yet. Call only after the user confirmed the cancellation summary. Returns a cancellation reference.

reason.description: Reason the customer gave for cancelling

line_items.description: Line numbers to cancel; omit to cancel all
